title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines' own state is read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now. Live starts are counted from 1 October 2026 for v005 and 9 October 2026 for v006. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. One trade says nothing about a strategy, and the record updates continuously.

## Open positions and closed-trade counts

The htf-rsi-v007 engine shows 0 positions open on paper. It has 4 closed trades so far, with an average null net per trade. The trend-daily-v005 engine shows the Bitcoin market filter off and 0 positions open on paper. It has 6 closed trades so far, with an average -13.22% net per trade. The trend-daily-v006 engine also shows the Bitcoin market filter off and 0 positions open on paper. It has 7 closed trades so far, with an average -13.34% net per trade. The record also shows a NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 that has been open since. These are paper states rather than filled orders, so they describe signal history and engine state, not realized trading results. The closed-trade averages are measurements of what has already happened; they are not forecasts of what the next trade will do. The null average shown for htf-rsi-v007 is the value in the record, with no further precision provided.

## The first closed trade in detail

The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is -17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The rule that produced the exit was the 10-day low condition; the measurement is the closing price of 1.703 on 18 October 2026; the result is a loss of 17.9% after costs. In testing, most trades lost and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. A single closed trade cannot validate or invalidate a strategy. It is one observation from a short live record that began on 1 October 2026 for v005 and 9 October 2026 for v006.

## What the market filter is allowing

With the Bitcoin market filter off, both trend-daily engines show 0 open positions. That state means the filter is not allowing trend-daily entries in this snapshot, while the closed-trade averages remain on the record: -13.22% net per trade for v005 across 6 trades and -13.34% net per trade for v006 across 7 trades. The nearest names to a 20-day breakout are still listed even with no positions open. For v005, AVAXUSDT is 8.56% below its high, TRXUSDT is 11.41% below its high, and XLMUSDT is 15.20% below its high. For v006, JUPUSDT is 8.39% below its high, AVAXUSDT is 8.56% below its high, and TRXUSDT is 11.41% below its high. These distances show how far each name is from its breakout level. They describe the market state around the filter; they are not instructions to enter or exit anything.

## Where the same numbers appear

The same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. This live snapshot was read at 2026-11-14T03:05:52.706Z. The record updates continuously, so the counts, averages, open positions, and filter state can change as new closes are processed. Because every position here is paper, the record tracks signal history rather than executed trades. The framing is the same everywhere: paper signals only, no real orders are placed anywhere in this record.

## Reading the record without overreading it

The record is a running account of engine state, not a verdict on future performance. A closed trade such as ATOM at -17.9% is a measurement of one outcome under one set of conditions. An average such as -13.22% or -13.34% summarizes several closed trades but does not remove the uncertainty in the next one. An open position such as NEAR at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 is simply open; it has not resolved into a gain or a loss. A filter that is off is a current state, not a permanent rule. The live starts on 1 October 2026 and 9 October 2026 mean the record is short, and short records can look very different from longer ones. The safest reading is descriptive: what is open, what closed, and what the filter is doing right now.
